description: Shelf.new([1, 2]).names, where names is @items.map { |i| i.to_s } : an Array of String. Four tiers at once: tier 5's array literal and elemTy, tier 7's ivar spine holding an arrayOf, tier 9c's still-unwritten higher-order rule for Array#map, and the tier-7-x-9 gap for a block reaching an instance method. The deepest rung in the corpus by feature count.
